{{Top|leg}}
The '''Stalimurans''' were a population of the [[Tionese (group)/Legends|Tionese]] people living on the [[Planet/Legends|world]] [[Stalimur]]. Similarly to Tionese on other worlds, the Stalimurans observed the holiday known as [[The Devouring (holiday)|the Devouring]].<ref name="Xim">{{SW|url=news/essential-atlas-extra-the-history-of-xim-and-the-tion-cluster|text=Essential Atlas Extra: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster|int=Xim Week: The History of Xim and the Tion Cluster}}</ref>
